title: Uniform stabilization for relatively bounded perturbations of generators of semigroup
summary: In this paper, we study the robustness of exponential stability for semigroups generated by linear operators under perturbations. Extending a classical result of Gibson's Stability Theorem, we show that if the generator of an analytic exponentially stable semigroup is perturbed by a class of relatively bounded operators satisfying certain assumptions, then exponential stability is preserved, provided the perturbed semigroup is strongly stable.
